_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); railroad signals

pit_profile.why: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +92% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.70; conservative 2yr -21%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -7.7%/yr (worst year FY10-FY20, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +7.1%/yr (Q4 2020 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +11.5%/yr (FY10-FY20 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY10-FY20); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNP (retrospective, 2021-02-05) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (51.5% downside to Bear $99 / +-1.6% upside to Bull $201) | Adj composite 2.10 vs market 3.80: gap -1.70 [OVERVALUED] | +92% above the EPP floor $106 (13x FY21E $8.19) | Conservative 2-yr case: -20.8% total (-10.4%/yr) | At 24.9x FY21E the 15% hurdle price $270 sits above the BULL case; carloads +3% in Q4 2020, forward revenue -1% (no FY21 revenue guide, Q4 2020 freight revenue); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
